prompt: Write the body (about 120 words) of a letter of representation from a personal injury lawyer to an auto insurer. The client was hurt in a hit while turning left. Ask that all contact go through the law firm, ask for the policy limits, and ask the insurer to keep all evidence. No salutation, no signature, no names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1410; do not mention it.)
text:
This letter confirms that our firm now represents the injured party in connection with the collision that occurred while our client was turning left at an intersection. Our client sustained injuries in the incident and is currently receiving medical care for them. Please direct all further communication regarding this claim to our office and do not contact our client directly, whether by telephone, mail, or in person.

We ask that you provide a written statement of the bodily injury liability limits under the policy that covers the other driver involved in this collision, along with confirmation of any other coverage that may apply. Please also issue a written acknowledgment of this letter within the time required by your state's claims handling rules.

Finally, we request that your company preserve all evidence related to this matter. This includes photographs, vehicle data and event recorder information, recorded statements, claim notes, repair estimates, and any dashcam or surveillance footage. Failure to preserve this material could seriously prejudice our client's claim. We look forward to your prompt response.
